div.b: Check 4 is the one to run first, not last

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 648px; height: 1px; padding-top: 789px; margin-left: 19px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
The client is not on public PyPI. It installs from an authenticated
private index, and many organizations route every package install
through an internal mirror that will not pass an extra index URL
through to the outside.
That is a policy change with a lead time measured in weeks, not a
command anyone can run on the day. It is the single most reliable
way for a first session to stop before it starts.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 664px; height: 1px; padding-top: 769px; margin-left: 717px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #00294D;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #00294D; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.b: There is no wrapper to build for this pillar

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 648px; height: 1px; padding-top: 789px; margin-left: 719px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #333333;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #333333; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
The agent reads seven source types: Hugging Face, Amazon S3,
Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, JFrog Artifactory,
GitLab Model Registry, and a local path. There is no custom
connector mechanism, so nobody should go looking for one.
Anything else goes through the local path: download the model to
the scanning host and scan it there. That is also the documented
route for a private Hugging Face repository.
